description: Return the current state of a work order created by dispatch.order: status, assignment, quote and timestamps. Same key as dispatch.order (the order's status_url, served over MCP). A self-serve OAuth token cannot have created an order, so it receives HTTP 402 payment_required (JSON-RPC -32002). Anonymous callers receive HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate. To be provisioned, POST JSON to https://steadywrk.app/api/integration-key-request or use https://steadywrk.app/developers/keys and a person reviews each request. Email fallback: hello@steadywrk.app.
name: dispatch.order_status

outputSchema.description: The order as recorded now (fulfilment.assigned=false means no contractor yet), or a business error passthrough such as Order not found.

title: Read a dispatch work order
